body_text:
Riemann's removable singularity theorem. If $f$ is holomorphic on
a punctured neighborhood of $z_0$ and bounded near $z_0$, then $f$
has a unique holomorphic extension to $z_0$. Equivalently, the
principal part of its Laurent expansion vanishes.
